existing.description: The La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship rewards high-achieving international students with a reduction of up to 25% off annual tuition fees for the duration of their course. Applicants are automatically considered after submitting an application for a course on the University's list of eligible courses, and the percentage awarded is set by weighted average mark: 20% for a WAM of 60 to 74.9 and 25% for a WAM of 75 or above. The scholarship is open from 10 February 2026 to 31 December 2027 for full fee-paying, non-sponsored international students who are not humanitarian or permanent visa holders. Recipients must maintain full-time enrolment and satisfactory academic progress.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand and be applying to start an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program
Be a new international student newly offered from 10 February 2026, commencing a 2026 or 2027 intake
Be a full fee-paying, non-sponsored student
Apply to a program in the List of eligible courses
Not be a humanitarian or other permanent visa holder
Meet all entry requirements and commence studies at any La Trobe University campus in Australia
Have passed the Genuine Student assessment, including financial checks, before being considered
existing.eligibility_summary: New international students who are citizens of a country other than Australia or New Zealand, apply to start an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program on La Trobe's list of eligible courses, are full fee-paying and non-sponsored, are not humanitarian or permanent visa holders, meet all entry requirements, commence at an Australian La Trobe campus, and have passed the Genuine Student assessment including financial checks.
benefits: 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the course (WAM 60 to 74.9)
25% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the course (WAM 75 or above)
May be combined with the Early Acceptance Grant to form a discount on first-year tuition fees, subject to all conditions being met for both offers
coverage: 20% of annual tuition fees for the duration of the course for holders of a WAM of 60 to 74.9 (ATAR equivalent 60 to 74)
25% of annual tuition fees for the duration of the course for holders of a WAM of 75 or above (ATAR equivalent 75+)
requirements: Check that the intended course appears in the List of eligible courses
Apply for an approved course at La Trobe University
No separate scholarship application is required — consideration is automatic
Pay the acceptance deposit listed in the Letter of Offer by the due date to secure the scholarship
documents: Offer of admission to an approved course
Evidence of meeting all entry requirements for the program
Completion of the Genuine Student assessment, including financial checks
Evidence of full fee-paying, non-sponsored (international fee-paying) status
existing.english_requirement: Applicants must meet all entry requirements for their program, which include La Trobe University's English language requirements; the scholarship page sets no separate English score.
application_method: Confirm the intended course is on the List of eligible courses
Submit a standard application for admission to that course
Meet all conditions in the Letter of Offer and accept the offer by paying the required deposit
The scholarship percentage appears in the Letter of Offer
existing.selection_notes: Recipients are selected by the University on the basis of the applicant's weighted average mark (WAM) and the overall eligibility of the course: a WAM of 60 to 74.9 receives 20% and a WAM of 75 or above receives 25%. Scholarships are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis, and the percentage awarded is included in the Letter of Offer.
existing.best_fit: New international students with an Australian-equivalent result of 60 or above applying to an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework course at a La Trobe campus.
existing.notes: The scholarship may not be deferred to future intakes or years, and the offer may be revoked if the recipient cannot secure a student visa for that intake. At Victorian campuses the discount is applied from the first semester as an upfront reduction; at Sydney campus it is applied from the second semester. Failure to meet condition(s) and pay the acceptance deposit on time may result in withdrawal of the scholarship.
existing.duration: Tuition fee discount for the duration of the course, applied each semester or each year as set out in the Letter of Offer
existing.application_period: Open from 10 February 2026 to 31 December 2027 for 2026 and 2027 intakes.
existing.deadline_display: Applications close 31/12/2027. The award was open from 10/02/2026 and the page status is Open, with automatic consideration rather than a separate scholarship form.
existing.program_type: Automatic tuition fee discount for high-achieving international students
